softwareInnerHero.title: Unleash Photorealistic Power in SketchUp
paragraphs: In the world of 3D design and architectural visualization, the standard for presenting a vision is photorealism. Chaos V-Ray for SketchUp is the industry-standard rendering plugin, transforming your robust SketchUp models into stunning, lifelike images, animations, and immersive experiences with production-ready quality.

By working within V-Ray’s advanced rendering environment, you leverage the power of physically-based light and materials to accurately simulate real-world conditions. V-Ray’s Interactive Rendering and V-Ray Vision (real-time) modes allow you to make critical design changes—adjusting a camera, tweaking a texture, or repositioning a light—and see the final, high-fidelity result instantaneously, accelerating your creative flow.

From rapid design iteration and creating precise material studies to generating final, award-winning stills and animations, V-Ray provides the comprehensive, professional toolset that ensures your SketchUp designs are visualized with ultimate realism and delivered with efficiency.

cardSections.subheading: Experience the industry-standard rendering engine optimized for SketchUp

items.title: Global Illumination
items.body: Realistic light simulation with advanced GI algorithms that accurately calculate indirect light bouncing throughout your scene for natural-looking results.

items.title: Physically-Based Materials
items.body: Create stunning materials using V-Ray’s comprehensive material system with accurate reflection, refraction, and subsurface scattering properties.

items.title: Interactive Rendering
items.body: Experience real-time feedback with V-Ray’s progressive rendering mode, allowing you to see changes instantly as you adjust lights and materials.

items.title: Advanced Camera Controls
items.body: Precise camera control with depth of field, motion blur, and exposure settings to create professional photography-quality renders.

items.title: Cloud Collaboration
items.body: Render remotely using V-Ray Cloud or share scenes with colleagues through Trimble Connect for seamless collaboration.

items.title: Extension Support
items.body: Enhance your workflow with V-Ray extensions including VR panorama creation, batch rendering, and custom shader development tools.
